h: Issakaba Returns sets opening weekend record for a Nollywood action film
p: Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen's Issakaba Returns has reportedly grossed ₦47.8 million in its opening weekend, the highest-ever debut for an action thriller at the Nigerian box office.
body: Nollywood action thriller Issakaba Returns has reportedly set a new box office record, earning ₦47.8 million in its opening weekend.
The figure makes it the highest-grossing debut ever for an action thriller at the Nigerian box office. The film premiered at a cinema in Victoria Island, Lagos, before its general cinema release.
Director Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen, popularly known as D'Guvnor, thanked everyone who bought tickets and supported the film, describing the achievement as more than just numbers.
more: It grossed ₦47.8 million in its opening weekend.
It is a record for a Nigerian action thriller.
It was directed by Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen.
